team.name: Gold Rushers
team.mission: Our objective is to be a welcoming team; we invite communication, transparency, and empathy. We will do this by leveraging in-person dialogue and including all members of the team as much as possible. Our success is not only code-based, but also highly dependent on our ability to communicate with one another. In addition to technical skills (e.g., Slack, Git, Java, Restful API's), we will strive to improve our soft-skills (e.g., communication, collaboration, organization, time management, adaptability, and others). We endeavor to be mindful of shortcomings and use them as opportunities. Our differences should be our strengths, not our weaknesses.

people.name: Autumn Luzovich
people.biography: Hello there. I am a Junior in the Computer Science Department. Currently, I'm following a general concentration with an eventual slight focus on networking and cybersecurity. Outside of when I'm either at school, work, or sleeping, you'll find me dabbling in Single Sign-On servers, self-hosted multimedia and productivity tools, and developing my own websites — of which I am an enthusiast.

people.name: Kyle Kirts
people.biography: My name is Kyle Kirts and I am currently a Senior studying Computer Science at Colorado State University. I enjoy statistics, visualizing data and figuring out how to comprehend it all. My current goals are to expand my skills within the field of Computer Science while attending CSU. In my free time I enjoy watching and keeping up with soccer or cooking a new recipe.

people.name: Sky Vercauteren
people.biography: Hey I'm Sky. A student at heart, dedicated to improving, discovering and incorporating new understandings. Versatile professional, with a passion for music and a creative background that expands my skillset. I got my bachelors in Computer Science from the University of Wyoming, and am taking this class in a multifaceted capacity to keep growing and having fun.

people.name: Ben Schlicting
people.biography: Hello I'm Ben! I transferred from front range last semester and this is my first year at CSU as a junior for computer science. I'm really into web/mobile development and have learned a lot from working at a startup with the goal eventually work there full time. In my free time I spend a lot of time play tennis actively playing on the CSU club team! I also love video games and I'm very excited to start playing Silksong this weeknd!
